subject: Post-discovery: model fit summary, prompt pack, and emergency mitigation options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Hugo Alvarez <hugo.alvarez@lumenpay.com>, LumenPay Technical <infra@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: model fit summary, prompt pack, and emergency mitigation options

Hi Hugo / LumenPay infra team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can move from discovery to a short eval window: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use: automated transaction categorization + short-form merchant name normalization for the mobile app.
- Constraints: sub-200ms tail latency target for synchronous endpoints; unacceptable rate of miscategorization (>1% critical errors across high-volume merchants).
- Data: you can share 200–500 redacted request/response pairs and the live sample set you want validated.

Redwood recommended starting models for the eval pack
- redwood/fast-infer-13B-8bit (cost-effective baseline)
- redwood/quality-34B-fp16 (higher-quality canonical model)

What I attached
- lumenpay_prompt_set_v1.csv [attachment: CSV prompt set with canonicalization cases]
- lumenpay_benchmarks_q2_2028.pdf [attachment: sample benchmark template + expectations]

Immediate asks / next steps
1) LumenPay: share 300–500 redacted examples (or a sampling link) and any failing examples you already saw.
2) We’ll run the prompt pack against both recommended models and return: accuracy delta, latency histogram, and a short list of counterexamples.
3) If you see quality degradation after a model update, we can pin to a specific model snapshot while we triage — see proposed emergency path below.

Emergency mitigation (high level) — if you need it quickly
- Temporary pin to a prior snapshot (e.g., redwood/quality-34B-fp16@2028-04-10) while we run the eval pack.
- If pinning isn’t acceptable, we can route a percentage of traffic to the baseline model (fast-infer-13B) as a fallback.

Timing
- If you can upload examples by EOD Wed (04/25), we’ll return an initial eval summary within 48 hours.

I’ll leave Rishi and Marissa on copy to coordinate the eval runs and timings. Thanks — looking forward to getting you a short, actionable report.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: lumenpay_prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV)]

From: Hugo Alvarez <hugo.alvarez@lumenpay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenPay Technical <infra@lumenpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 08:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model fit summary, prompt pack, and emergency mitigation options

Hi Soojin / Rishi —

Appreciate the recap. We started a small rollout of Redwood's ‘quality’ family last week and are seeing an uptick in hallucinated merchant names in a subset of mid-volume accounts (sample attached). Two quick examples below (redacted):

1) Input: "coffee shop - TX" -> Expected: "Brew & Co." -> Output: "Brew & Co. Cafe" (extra suffix changed downstream matching rules)
2) Input: "ACME Logistics" -> Expected: "ACME Logistics" -> Output: "Acme Logistics Intl" (introduced region token and capitalization differences that break downstream joins)

Attached: lumenpay_issue_examples.json [attachment: 10 sample requests + model responses] — these were from traffic after the model update on 2028-04-18.

Impact: the UI shows wrong merchant names to a small but measurable user cohort; product flagged this as a P1 for trust/regression. We can share up to 500 redacted samples by end of day.

Questions:
- Can Redwood immediately pin us to the snapshot you mentioned?
- If pinning is not possible, can we route affected merchant segments to a fallback model until triage completes?

Thanks — Hugo
Hugo Alvarez
Head of Product, LumenPay
[attachment: lumenpay_issue_examples.json (JSON)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Hugo Alvarez <hugo.alvarez@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model fit summary, prompt pack, and emergency mitigation options

Hi Hugo —

Thanks for the examples, that’s exactly what we need. Short plan to stabilize while we investigate: 

1) Emergency pin request: I’ve initiated an internal request to pin your production routing to redwood/quality-34B-fp16@2028-04-10. If approved it’s effectively a snapshot pin (no config changes on your side).
2) Collection: please share the 500 redacted examples and the raw request/response logs (timestamps, model version header, route) — we’ll ingest into an isolated eval run.
3) Diff analysis: we’ll run the prompt pack you have against the pinned snapshot and the current live snapshot and produce a model-diff-snapshot.txt listing top deltas (tokens with highest change score), plus a short eval report.
4) Rollback ladder if pinning is blocked: a) route 25% traffic to fast-infer-13B baseline + 75% live; b) iterate canary increases until stability.

Notes on SLAs / cost: pinning a snapshot is free operationally; routing split increases token usage by ~5–10% (can share exact numbers once we know your traffic distribution).

I’ll queue the eval runs as soon as we receive the samples (please upload to the Drive link Soojin shared or we can provide a temporary S3). 

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

>

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hugo Alvarez <hugo.alvarez@lumenpay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model fit summary, prompt pack, and emergency mitigation options

Hi Hugo —

Operational triage outline (detailed runbook we’ll execute):
- Step 1 (0–4 hrs after samples): validate sample set, check for data/content changes in requests (noise that could cause generation shifts).
- Step 2 (4–12 hrs): run diff between redwood/quality-34B-fp16@2028-04-10 and live snapshot; produce model-diff-snapshot.txt [attachment].
- Step 3 (12–36 hrs): run the full prompt pack against both snapshots and generate the bench report (accuracy, confusion matrix, latency percentiles).
- Step 4 (36–72 hrs): if discrepancy > threshold (we’ll use your 1% critical error), propose either pin (preferred) or staged rollback with canary percentages.

Immediate ask: please grant the Drive upload link edit access or drop the files into S3; we need the raw logs and the 500 redacted examples. Also confirm whether the merchant matching downstream rules have changed in the last 30 days.

Attached for your reference: model-diff-snapshot.txt [attachment stub].

We’ll update the HubSpot deal and attach the triage artifacts so your team can track. I’ve flagged this as a P1 on our side and looped engineering standby.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: model-diff-snapshot.txt (TXT)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Hugo Alvarez <hugo.alvarez@lumenpay.com>, LumenPay Technical <infra@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model fit summary, prompt pack, and emergency mitigation options

Hugo —

Thanks for the quick responses and the example set. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 
- You: upload the 500 redacted samples + raw request/response logs to the Drive link by EOD today (I’m keeping the window open until 18:00 PT).
- Redwood: Rishi & engineering will pin to redwood/quality-34B-fp16@2028-04-10 immediately after we confirm the samples are intact. Monica will run the diff and the prompt-pack bench.
- We’ll populate the HubSpot deal with the artifacts and expected timelines: https://hubspot.company/deal/LUM-2028-0423

Fallback plan (if pin rejected by compliance): route 25% traffic to redwood/fast-infer-13B-8bit while we complete a deeper investigation. We’ll monitor user-facing error rate and have daily check-ins until the issue is closed.

Attachments for your review: lumenpay_benchmarks_q2_2028.pdf (benchmark template we’ll use).

I’ll set up a 15-minute check-in tomorrow morning to confirm upload and to align on rollback cadence. Appreciate your partnership on this — we want to get your production back to the expected quality quickly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: lumenpay_benchmarks_q2_2028.pdf (PDF)]
